node.statement: Fix any def-stage1-polar-witness-data tuple W satisfying C_ch >= C_ch^0 and 0 < kappa_ch <= kappa_ch^0, and any root inputs satisfying C_ch*(epsilon_r+delta) <= kappa_ch. With the choices in 1.1.1 and s from 1.1.3, C_hat*s <= C_ch*s <= kappa_ch <= kappa_hat. Thus C_hat*(epsilon_r+delta) <= kappa_hat, exactly the smallness hypothesis of lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control.
